inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: One classroom was observed watching PJ Masks during lunchtime. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver closed the laptop being used to watch tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: One room had two children that were more than 18 months older than the youngest child.    The children were moved to another room during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Two nap mats had tears exposing the foam.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: A caregiver?s background check was not inactivated within 7 days of them no longer being associated with the operation.   The background was deactivated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation failed to follow one of the conditions of the probation. The operation is required to hold quarterly meetings with employees to review the progress of the probation. Four employees did not attend the meeting for the second quarter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation failed to follow one of the conditions of the probation. The operation was required to conduct a staff meeting to discuss probation progress each quarter. This due date was the end of September, and the staff meeting was not conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Grass was observed growing through the pea gravel creating a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface: Anchoring equipmet was exposed under one piece of play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface (26 TAC §746.4601(6))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One caregiver completed CPR online without a hands-on portion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: As required by conditions of the probation, the operation failed to create a plan to ensure that ratio is met at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One classroom was three children over ratio based on the specified age group. This was corrected at inspection when the director moved three children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill on the playground did not meet the required depth of 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child did not have two immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The director was not present at the operation for 30 hours or 75% of the program's operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The director was not present at the operation for 30 hours or 75% of the program's operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing: The person in charge could not give CCR access to children's files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: The person in charge could not gain access to personnel files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child did not have two immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child did not have a physician statment available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At arrival, there was one teacher in charge of 10 infants. This was corrected when an additional caregiver came into the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The director was not present at the beginning of the inspection. The person in charge did not have access to personnel or child files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers did not have CPR training. One caregiver had CPR training however it was solely online and did consists of hands-on instruction, practice and testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver gave the wrong number of children in their care.  The caregiver was asked twice and gave the wrong number each time.     This was corrected when the inspector pointed out that there was one more child than stated and the caregiver gave the correct number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: There is enough evidence to support that a child was being placed in a highchair as a form of discipline and guidance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There is enough evidence to support that the operation put an older child in the infant room that was older than 18 months from the youngest infant in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 11 month old was sleeping in a crib with a bottle. This was corrected when the bottle was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: One infant fell asleep while drinking a bottle in their crib. This was corrected when the bottle was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation does not have a current sanitation inspection. The director has requested and paid for a sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The caregiver in charge did not have access to records as the office door was locked. This was corrected when the caregiver called another employee to come and unlock the office door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was present with five infants ages 4 months to 18 months. The specified age group of the class was 0-11 months old. The child caregiver ratio for the specified age group is one caregiver to four infants. This was corrected when another caregiver came into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a Children's Product Certification form available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Three infants were in bouncer seats without the safety straps fastened. This was corrected when two infants were removed from the bouncer seats and one infant's safety straps were fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infants were sleeping in restrictive devices. This was corrected when the infants were removed from the restrictive devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two caregivers were present with children without having background check eligibility letters. The caregivers left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A three month old was sleeping in a crib on a boppy pillow. This was corrected when a caregiver removed the boppy pillow from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: A 2 year old was sleeping with a blanket covering their head. This was corrected when the caregiver uncovered the child's head.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: Based on the evidence gathered during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver spanked their own child in a classroom during operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver failed to demonstrate good judgement by tying a child's shoes too tight, resulting in red blisters on the child's feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: There was no policy regarding procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs in the operation's handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: There were two caregivers who did not have current certification in First Aid or CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Two staff records that were read still did not have education qualifications. One caregiver did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: There were 22 children with a specified age of 2 years observed playing outside with one caregiver. This was corrected when another caregiver came outside to join the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Three staff records were not available for review. Two staff records that were read did not have education qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: The fenced outdoor area only had one exit for children to use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: One infant was observed to be sleeping in a restrictive device  with a blanket. The infant was removed and placed in a bare crib during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver counted in ratio in the infant classroom was found to have an incomplete background check pending fingerprinting.  The caregiver was replaced with an eligilbe caregiver during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: One infant was observed to be sleeping in a restrictive device that had been placed in a crib.  The infant was removed and placed in a bare crib during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There were 13 children ages 4 months - 2 years old observed in one classroom with two caregivers during nap time. The youngest infant was 21 months younger than the oldest child in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: One infant was observed eating in a highchair without the safety straps buckled.  This was brought into compliance when a caregiver buckled the straps during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Thirteen children ages 4 months - 2 years of age were observed in a classroom with two caregivers.  The specified age for the group of children was 10 months of age.  This was corrected at the inspection when children were picked up or transferred to a different classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Hinged Lid Storage Containers Safe: One outdoor storage trunk was observed to not be equipped with a hinged lid.  The trunk was moved to be inaccessible to children during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Hinged Lid Storage Containers Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There was one 4 year old child observed napping in a classroom with infants under 18 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the investigation inspection it was found that the operation's carpets were not kept clean and there were food crumbs and dirt visible on the carpets and floors. The bathroom in the school age room had toilet paper, dirt, and dried urine on the toilet, floor, and in an unused shower.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Location of Toilets: During the investigation inspection it was found that the school age bathroom was not equipped with toilet paper and the caregiver did not have access to get any to replace it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Toilets (26 TAC §746.4409)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the investigation inspection the director left the operation and the person left in charge did not have access to all of the information needed by licensing. Person in charge was also counted in ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: One caregiver was observed leaving a classroom of ten,  16 month-4 year old children unsupervised during nap while another caregiver stood between their two classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A caregvier was found unsing their phone for personal use while caring for children. This was corrected when the phone was put away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
